definitions.short: lime (from being burned in a kiln)
definitions.full: H1615. gir גִּר noun [masculine] chalk, lime (perhaps Aramaic loan-word compare Frä 9 ; Aramaic (also Biblical Aramaic) גִּיר ; Arabic is loan-word Frä l.c .) — גִר כְּאַבְנֵי מִזְבֵּחַ Isa 27:9 .

occurrences.englishText: Therefore by this the iniquity of Jacob will be forgiven, and this is all the fruit of taking away his sin: that he makes all the stones of the altar as chalk stones that are beaten in pieces, so that the Asherah poles and the incense altars shall rise no more.
